metric_definitions.embedding_collapse_score: Legacy name: (mean off-diagonal cosine + 1)/2 for up to 2048 sampled real-item embeddings, seed 42. Measures directional alignment; alone it does not establish collapse or recommendation diversity.
metric_definitions.embedding_alignment_sample_count: Number of sampled real-item embeddings; alignment is null when fewer than two exist.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_margin_mean: Mean positive-minus-negative logit over positions where both item IDs are nonzero. Scale-sensitive training-sample diagnostic, not validation performance.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_margin_p10: Nearest-rank tenth percentile of positive-minus-negative logit over the same valid positions.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_neg_beats_pos_rate: Fraction of valid margins strictly below zero.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_small_margin_rate: Fraction of valid margins strictly below eps=0.5; scale-sensitive.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_margin_count: Observed valid positive/negative comparisons from at most ten diagnostic batches. Missing measurements are null with a reason.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_margin_category_breakdown: Legacy fields retained. Category lists are empty because item-category metadata is unavailable; position counts remain measured.
metric_definitions.padding_verification: Float32 eval-mode, identical-weight feature and candidate-score comparisons against a zero-initial-state compact-event GRU reference. Tests unpadded execution, baseline and extra leading padding, batch companions and empty rows. atol=1e-5, rtol=1e-4. Temporal results are gated on passing every comparison. No diagnostic-only architecture correction is applied.

temporal_audit.scope: Deterministic training-prefix fallback: target=history[-1], context=history[:-1] truncated to the configured baseline cap, at least four context events. These targets were available during fitting; realized exact user-target interaction exposure remains unknown without a sampler ledger. Repeated target occurrences in context are recorded separately. This does not estimate unseen-interaction generalization.
temporal_audit.candidates: Target plus 99 distinct real-item negatives excluding the complete training history, sampled with a local SHA256-derived seed-42 user RNG. Identical candidates across all variants; insufficient catalogs are skipped and counted. These are diagnostic candidates, not reconstructed host validation candidates.
temporal_audit.variants: Original; latest item only; five deterministic prefix shuffles preserving multiplicities, length and latest item; recent-prefix deletion prefix[:-k]+[latest]; oldest-prefix deletion prefix[k:]+[latest], k=max(1,len(prefix)//4). Unchanged shuffles are retained and counted. Shuffles average outcomes within user, never scores or checkpoints.
temporal_audit.outcomes: One-based target rank with ascending item-ID tie breaking; reciprocal rank=1/rank; HR@10=1[rank<=10]; sampled-candidate top-10 Jaccard against original. Every variant uses left padding and the greatest nonzero input index for readout.
temporal_audit.paired_effects: Variant-minus-original rank, HR@10 and reciprocal-rank differences. Matched deletion effects are recent-deleted minus oldest-deleted; positive rank or negative HR differences mean greater damage from recent deletion. Effects describe input perturbation sensitivity, not causal preferences.
temporal_audit.uncertainty: 2000 paired user bootstrap replicates, local numpy seed 42, percentile 95% intervals. Category intervals are separate from macro intervals. aggregate_temporal_audits requires all four padding-verified category results, independently resamples users within categories and averages four category effects equally. Missing categories make macro results unavailable. Intervals condition on fitted checkpoints, realized candidates and perturbations and exclude retraining, negative-sampling and repeated-search uncertainty.
temporal_audit.limitations: No ratings, review text, prices, stores, item categories or simulator traits are observed. Sampled-candidate overlap is distinct from native full-catalog unseen-item overlap and the pinned validation objective. No full-catalog overlap is measured by this panel.
